mapper.select: select id, version, title, kb_id, user_id, robot_id, workflow_id, tenant_id, llm_model_id, system_prompt, temperature, max_tokens, message_count, total_tokens, total_cost, status, created_at, updated_at, last_message_at from ai_chat_session where id = #{sessionId}

select id, version, title, kb_id, user_id, robot_id, workflow_id, tenant_id, llm_model_id, system_prompt, temperature, max_tokens, message_count, total_tokens, total_cost, status, created_at, updated_at, last_message_at from ai_chat_session where user_id = #{userId} order by last_message_at desc nulls last, created_at desc
mapper.update: update ai_chat_session set version = version + 1, title = #{title}, kb_id = #{kbId}, user_id = #{userId}, tenant_id = #{tenantId}, llm_model_id = #{llmModelId}, system_prompt = #{systemPrompt}, temperature = #{temperature}, max_tokens = #{maxTokens}, message_count = #{messageCount}, total_tokens = #{totalTokens}, total_cost = #{totalCost}, status = #{status}, updated_at = now(), last_message_at = #{lastMessageAt} where id = #{id} and version = #{version}
mapper.select: select id, version, title, kb_id, user_id, robot_id, workflow_id, tenant_id, llm_model_id, system_prompt, temperature, max_tokens, message_count, total_tokens, total_cost, status, created_at, updated_at, last_message_at from ai_chat_session where status = 'ACTIVE' and (last_message_at is null or last_message_at < current_timestamp - interval '30 days') order by last_message_at asc nulls first
select count(*) from ai_chat_session where user_id = #{userId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
